finding.title: Certificate marker rebind still required legacy enrollment version 1
finding.trigger: A current version-2 enrollment followed by internal Redis CA rotation would reject ENROLLMENT_MARKER_REBIND_REJECTED before controller authorization.
finding.effect: Rotation/recovery could not complete for current integrated role profile; this was a release-blocking lifecycle compatibility defect.
finding.rootCause: Rotator retained v1 guard after enrollment moved to v2/accountPolicyVersion1; earlier rotation fixtures also used v1.
finding.correction: Accept current v2 complete marker only; reuse existing strongHash and verifyAccounts with service enabled/private ACL checks before any marker write and after readback. Preserve core-only behavior and all non-config-hash fields; do not migrate or repair roles during maintenance.
